result.summary: Found 1 issue: the promotional banner text has insufficient color contrast against its light background, making it nearly unreadable.

issues.description: Promotional banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is white on a very light mint background with extremely low contrast and is barely readable.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color or darken the banner background to meet WCAG contrast requirements for readability.
